leadRow.title: Japan FSA publishes analytical report on IT resilience in the financial sector
leadRow.source: Primary / Financial Services Agency of Japan / 2026-07-30

evidence.sourceTitle: Japan FSA publishes analytical report on IT resilience in the financial sector
evidence.significance: Japan’s FSA report treats IT resilience as a financial-sector operating issue shaped by cyber, geopolitical and third-party risk. The practical test is whether firms can recover important services and learn from failure.

evidence.organisation: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority
evidence.significance: The ESAs put frontier-AI ICT risk inside the supervisory conversation, linking governance, cyber prevention, detection, response and critical third-party oversight. Firms should map those expectations to real control evidence.
